record.one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Advertising API) for managing ad accounts, campaigns, targeting and reporting on LinkedIn.
record.auth_notes: Member (3-legged) OAuth 2.0 is required for Marketing APIs; 2-legged application auth is not supported for them.
record.access_notes: Self-serve developer app, but Advertising API permissions must be approved via the Developer Portal (Products tab, add Advertising API); Audiences needs approved Advertising API partner status. critic: access approval_required confirmed against vendor getting-access page; no free/trial path without approval.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST endpoints under api.linkedin.com/rest covering ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, targeting facets/entities and audience counts. Marketing version 202601 sunsets 2027-01-15.
record.blocker_notes: Advertising API product must be approved by LinkedIn before real ad-account access. critic: no official LinkedIn MCP server found; several third-party sources (Markifact, PaidSync, AdPlug) state LinkedIn has not published one.

evidence.quote: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member (user) authorization and API authentication.
Developers seeking to build a marketing related integration using Advertising API permissions must be approved.
This MCP server connects Claude Desktop (or any MCP-compatible client) to the LinkedIn Marketing API
First-party building blocks, no official MCP
Audiences permissions may be applied for after becoming an approved Advertising API partner.

input.query: LinkedIn Ads MCP server official LinkedIn Marketing Solutions
